item.tib: lha 'dre'i spring yig snang srid zil gnon
item.coloph: ces bya ba'i spring yig 'di yang / khyung mchog grub pa'i dbang phyug bstan 'dzin rin chen rgyal mtshan bde chen snying po can gyis springs so/ de yang spring yig snang srid zil gnon zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khyung dkar ru ba'i sprang 'khyams po grub ming du 'bod pas/ snang srid dbang du bsdus phyir gang shar bris pas 'gro kun dpal du bkra shis rgyur gyur cig/
